content:
Archer. Now and as a Bonus Action on later turns: a luminous arrow at one creature within 60 ft — +9 to hit, 2d8 + 5 Radiant.

Chalice. When you cast a spell with a slot that restores HP, you or a creature within 30 ft can regain 2d8 + 5.

Dragon. On Intelligence and Wisdom checks and Concentration saves, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
